messages:
jamal: Heads-up: Grafana alerted on token-level 95th pct latency for route /v1/generate-chat. Spike started ~15:43 UTC, sustained ~6m. Link: https://grafana.internal/r/abcd1234 :eyes:

jamal: Here's the quick breakdown I saw in the token-latency panel: overall 95p = 170ms, but per-token breakdown shows token 1-8 ~40ms, token 9+ tail climbs to 250ms. KV-cache hit rate for that route dropped to 62% at the same time.

tess: Ugh, that sounds like KV TTL churn or kernel fallback. Any recent kernel rollouts?

maria: No kernel rollout in that window. I checked commit history — last kernel switch was yesterday afternoon. Could be batching heuristic change from the autoscaler though.

jamal: Devops alert fired: devops-bot: ALERT runtime_token_latency_burnrate /v1/generate-chat 95p > 150ms for 5m (burnrate=2.8). Page sent to eng-oncall.

devops-bot: @oncall_eng experienced an alert: runtime_token_latency_high (group: token-latency). Triggered at 2026-08-11T15:43:21Z. Current value: 170ms (95th). Escalation: page -> #eng-oncall -> oncall mobile.

simo: Quick triage thoughts: 1) KV cache miss spike explains tail rise. 2) When KV misses increase, kernel selection may switch to a lower-throughput kernel for longer sequences. 3) Batching might be inflating latency if many short requests get stuck behind a long one.

maria: I ran a PromQL query to correlate kv miss and token tail: 

`sum(rate(runtime_kv_miss_total{route="/v1/generate-chat"}[5m])) by (instance)` 
`/ sum(rate(runtime_kv_req_total{route="/v1/generate-chat"}[5m])) by (instance)`

Result: cluster-wide miss ratio jumped from 0.12 to 0.38 in the 15:40-15:46 window. Also: `runtime_kernel_fallbacks_total` increased by ~14 events clustered on node-gpu-07.

tess: Good correlation. Can we confirm if the KV TTL policy recently changed? Maybe some prefixes aged out.

maria: Checked infra config: no TTL change. BUT noticed a small rollout of batching heuristic tweak at 15:30 that increases max batch wait for long-seq jobs (PR #4128).

jamal: That could cause short requests to wait behind long ones. Can we test reverting the heuristic or add a per-route override for /v1/generate-chat?

simo: Proposed quick mitigation: set an alerting rule and automated action. 1) Add a per-route SLO alert: if 95p token latency > 150ms AND kv_miss_ratio > 0.25 for 3m, trigger a non-paging critical and auto-toggle batching to conservative mode for that route. 2) Paging threshold remains burnrate >= 3 for 5m.

maria: Draft alert rule (YAML):

```
- alert: RouteTokenLatencyHigh
  expr: |
    (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(runtime_token_latency_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate-chat"}[5m])) by (le))) > 0.15
    and (sum(rate(runtime_kv_miss_total{route="/v1/generate-chat"}[3m]))
         / sum(rate(runtime_kv_req_total{route="/v1/generate-chat"}[3m]))) > 0.25
  for: 3m
  labels:
    severity: critical
  annotations:
    summary: "High token tail + KV miss for /v1/generate-chat"
    runbook: "Run KV cache warmup, toggle conservative batching, check node-gpu-07"
```

maria: And an automated action (pseudo):

```
if alert RouteTokenLatencyHigh:
  api: POST /internal/runtime/routes/v1/generate-chat/overrides
  body: {"batching_mode": "conservative", "kv_prefetch": true}
```

tess: I like that. Also add a Grafana panel with per-route kernel fallback count and per-token heatmap to make cause discovery faster.

jamal: For the short-term rollback, can ops flip PR #4128 for batching heuristic? Maria, can you coordinate?

maria: Will open rollback PR and schedule a conservative rollout. Also will add the new alert rule to the staging alert group for 2 days to validate false positive rate.

simo: Assigning follow-ups: maria -> rollback + alert rule, tess -> dashboard panels, jamal -> monitor oncall and keep eng-runtime loop. :thumbsup:

jamal: Thanks all. If paging hits >1 per hour for this route after changes, escalate to infra-exec.

tess: Noted. Will add dashboard annotations for changes so we can correlate. :white_check_mark:

maria: Updating timeline in the ticket: rollback PR opened 15:58 UTC, will rollout canary at 16:10, monitor 20m then promote.

jamal: Closing loop here — please drop updates in this thread when the canary shows normalized 95p < 120ms.

simo: Will do.
